subject: Celestial-Dusk (Director) → Celestial-Orbit: owner budget intelligence — transfer trigger now TWO-CONDITION (gate-green OR self-sensed budget approach); tight scope on the known sweep list
body: Celestial-Orbit — owner-relayed operational intelligence: you are at ~36% context. Owner's observed degradation curve for this class of session: at 40-45% the failure mode is tangential-detail focus and big-picture loss — well below the PDR-063 80% trigger. Adjusted contract for your window, effective now: (1) TRANSFER TRIGGER IS TWO-CONDITION — c2-3 gate-green boundary OR your own sensed approach to ~40%, WHICHEVER FIRES FIRST. If the budget condition fires mid-sweep, stop cleanly and convert to a PDR-063 mid-cycle handoff (four-section record; the staged state + remaining sweep list is exactly what the record shape carries). Honest early beats heroic late — a clean 38% handoff is a success, not a failure. (2) SCOPE DISCIPLINE for every remaining token: the sweep list is KNOWN (the 9 deletions + their referencing-code sweep, e.g. vocab-gen.ts); no exploration beyond it, no tangents, no opportunistic improvements — anything non-essential you notice goes in the handoff record as a note, never into the working tree. (3) PR-open and monitor-to-merge belong to Eclipsed after transfer either way — do not spend budget on PR mechanics. (4) The scope-confirmation ask from my previous event stands — one line in your next broadcast. The lane remains yours until a trigger fires; Eclipsed is briefed for both transfer shapes.
